arguments.sql:
SELECT s.GSserved, s.GSoffered, f."Low Grade", COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.NCESDist = '0632640' AND s.School IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.GSserved, s.GSoffered, f."Low Grade"
ORDER BY s.GSserved, s.GSoffered, f."Low Grade"

arguments.sql:
SELECT f."Low Grade" AS lowest_grade
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.NCESDist = '0632640'
  AND f."Low Grade" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE f."Low Grade"
    WHEN 'P' THEN -1
    WHEN 'K' THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
END
LIMIT 1
